Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please study the following scholarship on digital edition rendering and separation of data from presentation:

  • Huskey, Samuel J. "Developing a New Integrated Editing Platform for Source Documents in Classics." Digital Humanities Quarterly, 2024. Focus on § 3 (Treating layout and visualization as a separate scholarly concern).
  • Pierazzo, Elena. "Digital Scholarly Editing in Practice: Making the Oxford University Voltaire." Digital Scholarly Editing: Theories and Practices, Open Book Publishers, 2016, pp. 47–70. (Generating diplomatic and reading views from one XML master).
  • TEI Consortium. "Chapter 11: Representation of Primary Sources." TEI P5: Guidelines for Electronic Text Encoding and Interchange, Version 4.8.0, 2024. § 11.3 (Display decisions, milestone tags, and parallel segmentation).
